The '''Caridan district''' was a section of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carida/Legends|Carida]]. Located just outside the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]], the district was well-known for its booming nightlife.
